How we bake sourdough

Flour, water, salt, time, and a starter that has been alive longer than the shop has. The interesting part is the time: everything else can be measured, and time is the ingredient people try to skip.

The starter

Fed twice a day with the same rye it was born on. A starter that has been neglected can be brought back, but it will taste like the neglect for a week.

The bake

Hot, steam for the first ten minutes, then dry. A loaf that goes in without steam looks fine and cuts badly, which is the closest thing baking has to a silent failure.
